name: Russia
summary: Russia, Day 241. Moscow is bidding to be the fourth channel on Iran: Lavrov's first wartime visit to Tehran (19 Oct), a GCC dialogue in Manama (18 Oct), Putin's offer of mediation to Witkoff (21 Oct) and Pezeshkian in Moscow on 27 Oct. The one concrete asset it brings, custody of Iran's enriched uranium, was refused by Rezaei ('not a single gram'). On energy the 11-Oct 'energy ceasefire' collapsed within days, the Trump–Putin diesel flows are modest, and Urals has swung from a premium to a ~$31 discount to Dated.

top_edges.context: CONFIRMED meetings: Lavrov's first Tehran visit of the war (19 Oct), Putin's mediation offer to Witkoff (21 Oct), Pezeshkian–Putin 27 Oct scheduled. 8.5→9.0. Content (custody) blocked by Rezaei.
11–12 Nov: Ust-Luga strike lifted diesel Wednesday; the Abu Dhabi prisoner-exchange deal pressed crude Thursday (Reuters relay). Flagged for review if a second week repeats (MAC-E).

recent_signals.headline: Russia's MFA (Maksimov, deputy head of the Middle East department, via Euronews Persian): 'It cannot be ruled out that, if diplomatic efforts fail, the military option will be employed.' Rezaei says Moscow was told the enriched material stays in Iran; Ghalibaf claims US officials asked Putin to broker talks (Kremlin silent). Ambassador to the US Darchiev died at 66 (MFA).

Russia–Ukraine: negotiators agreed 'a major prisoner exchange' after two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi (Reuters relay) — cited for Thursday's crude dip; Ukraine's drones struck Russia's Ust-Luga port (fire, tank damage; Leningrad governor: three workers hurt), cited for Wednesday's diesel rise. Raymond James (Molchanov): 'we will believe it when we see it'.

Deputy FM Gharibabadi met Russia's ambassador Dedov in Tehran (10 Nov): 'countering unilateral US actions' and 'the so-called Iron Gate plan', the Caspian; 'Tehran and Moscow emphasize the need for coordination'. No Kremlin/MFA readout.

**TWO SINGLE-SOURCE RUSSIA ITEMS (6–7 Nov):** Al-Araby Al-Jadeed: Washington asked Moscow to mediate and Putin urged Rezaei to negotiate directly with the US; the Telegraph (one senior Iranian official): Iran negotiating for S-400s. No Kremlin comment. Ukraine hit the Afipsky refinery (6 Nov) — diesel stays tight. (REPORTED; intel DIP-B3, MAC-A8)

**RUSSIA HOSTS IRAN'S SECURITY CHIEF; WARNS ITS CITIZENS (5 Nov).** Putin met Rezaei (Kremlin confirms; 'ready to help' per Rezaei's account only); Zakharova advised Russians to 'temporarily refrain' from travel to Iran (REPORTED). Russia's MFA warned of 'risk of a new escalation' (CBS 16:10 UTC). Ukraine struck Russian refineries again (Ryazan), supporting diesel. Abu Dhabi talks 10–11 Nov. (intel DIP-A5, KIN, MAC-A3)

Kremlin named its delegation for the 10–11 Nov Abu Dhabi Russia–Ukraine talks; no news timed to Wednesday's oil break. Missed 2 Nov: Rezaei–Putin contact; Zakharova: new US action 'extremely alarming'. (intel MAC-B2, DIP-B4)

Kremlin confirmed three-way Russia–Ukraine–US talks in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 Nov (Reuters, 3 Nov; Media Line: dates 'being considered') — a non-Iran bearish driver for crude; Ukraine set fire to a major refinery in Yaroslavl (bullish diesel). No Moscow statement on Iran 3–4 Nov. Note: Mitrade's 'US–Iran talks in Abu Dhabi' is a conflation. (REPORTED; intel MAC-B2, DIP-A11)

Rezaei–Putin call (2 Nov; Iranian readout only): thanks for 'firm positions', 'strategic cooperation in line with the roadmap set out by the leaders' — nothing on uranium, guarantees, the UN or US talks. Zakharova (2 Nov): signs of new military action 'extremely alarming… Those threatening new attacks today should consider this'; the blockade 'illegal'. No UNSC meeting or draft. (CONFIRMED; intel DIP-A12)

Pezeshkian–Putin (Kremlin, 27 Oct, GECF sidelines): trade +10.4% Jan–Aug; 'We are fulfilling all our obligations' incl. Bushehr; no uranium-custody or mediation outcome in any readout (TASS, Tasnim, Kyiv Post). Rosatom to raise Bushehr staffing to 200; AEOI says an SMR deal is being finalised (28 Oct). AP/AURORAH (28 Oct): Russian satellites passed over the targets of 40 Houthi and Iraqi-militia attacks on Saudi Arabia (1 Jul–19 Oct), 'a 100% match' — capability, not proof of transfer; anonymous Saudi and Houthi officials say Russian (and Chinese) imagery reaches the Houthis via Iranian advisers; Moscow silent; Faisal met Lavrov in Atlanta (30–31 Oct). Ukraine resumed refinery strikes 29–30 Oct (Novak: three refineries and a gas-chemical complex; Novokuibyshevsk, two killed) after a reported two-week lull. (CONFIRMED meeting/strikes; REPORTED AURORAH; intel DIP-A9, KIN-A8, SAU-B2, ISR-A13)

**MOSCOW BIDS TO BE THE FOURTH CHANNEL.** Lavrov at the Russia–GCC dialogue in Manama (18 Oct) and in Tehran (19 Oct, first visit of the war): 'readiness to help find acceptable negotiated solutions'; Bushehr staff to 'soon return'. Putin offered Witkoff Russian mediation on Iran (St Petersburg, 21 Oct; CNN/Axios). Pezeshkian meets Putin in Moscow 27 Oct (GECF). But Rezaei (20 Oct): 'Not a single gram' of enriched uranium leaves Iran — the HEU-custodian route is blocked. Energy: the 11-Oct 'energy ceasefire' collapsed ~15 Oct (Ukraine hit Ryazan); Trump–Putin diesel flows modest (~156–210 kt loaded 11–20 Oct, Kpler; first US-bound cargo 22 Oct); Urals ~$80 FOB, a ~$31 discount to Dated. (CONFIRMED meetings; REPORTED content/flows; intel DIP-A10, ISR-A13–A15)

**Moscow inserts itself on three tracks at once.** (1) Putin–Pezeshkian (Avaza, 8 Oct): Russia will 'do everything' to help; Putin–Trump call (9 Oct, ~90 min): HEU-custody offer 'remains in force', a ground operation in Iran 'unacceptable'; Kremlin says Trump 'welcomed Moscow's involvement' — CLAIMED (no WH readout). (2) Trump–Putin diesel deal: OFAC general licence on Russian diesel to 7 Apr 2027; Russia lifts its export ban early (300kt Oct/500kt Nov/1Mt Dec per Novak — volumes conflict); claimed 'energy ceasefire' (11 Oct) unconfirmed by Moscow; EU ministers call it 'concerning' and adopt the largest Russia sanctions listing yet (12 Oct). (3) Bloomberg (9 Oct, Western officials): Russia supplying Iran with missiles — REPORTED; White House rejects. Russia's Jan–Sep oil/gas tax take fell 17% y/y despite Urals ~$92 (Reuters 5 Oct); Urals traded at a premium to Brent (~+$3.30, early Oct). — mixed tags.

**Lavrov positions Moscow as guarantor of the Gulf–Iran track: the meeting is postponed 'for several days' and will convene 'in one of the cities of the Sultanate of Oman in the near future' — no Omani confirmation of any date. Also accused Austria of 'grossly' violating obligations by excluding AEOI chief Eslami.** TASS carried Araghchi's 'agreed with Oman' line. Diplomatic signalling, not fact. (TASS; oprep) — REPORTED/RHETORIC.

Putin attended BRICS New Delhi (12–13 Sep); the Declaration's refusal to name the US is the Russian/Chinese position in effect. Separately (non-Iran): Russia rejected another attempt to reopen Black Sea grain flows and Ukrainian exporters were told to prepare for months without deep-water ports — the primary driver of the +10–18% 1M grain rally (Grain Central/DTN), which the brief must NOT attribute to Hormuz.

**A1 / A8 RUSSIA-HEU-CUSTODIAN PATH STRUCTURALLY DISPLACED — TRUMP PUBLICLY SUBSTITUTED CHINA FOR RUSSIA AT THE CUSTODIAN ROLE AT BEIJING SUMMIT DAY 1**: 'only Washington or Beijing can retrieve Iran's nuclear material if Tehran agrees to hand it over' (CONFIRMED RHETORIC — Times of Israel May 14 liveblog primary). US officials had reportedly ruled out Russia-as-custodian per multiple May reports. The Russia-HEU-custodian non-event is now MEANINGFUL at Day 15 of 21 from Putin-Araghchi: no formal Russia announcement, AND today's Trump statement explicitly pivots jurisdiction. Even if Putin reactivates the offer, US has publicly pivoted. The 21-day window (closes May 18) is operationally vestigial. Pravda May 14: silent on Trump's China-HEU statement (Russian state-media protecting institutional position of unannounced offer). TASS continues to amplify EIA forecast cuts as 'the West cannot sustain $100 oil' = Russian state-media continues to amplify the bearish-oil case (commercial-strategic alignment with Russia's preferred narrative that war pressure on US is structural). Russian-oil waiver to India (~1.9 mbpd) preserved.

recent_signals.headline: **RUSSIA IS ABSENT FROM THIS PHASE OF THE IRAN WAR AND CONSUMED BY ITS OWN CHOKEPOINT CRISIS.** No new TASS statement or UNSC session 17-18 Jul; Moscow abstained on UNSC resolution 2817 (adopted 13-0) and continues to challenge snapback's legality alongside China. Moscow seeing no upside in owning the Iranian position is itself a signal about how Iran's patrons read its prospects. Meanwhile the Black Sea war hardened into a CONFIRMED CLOSURE: Ukrainian naval drones struck 100+ Russian vessels in eight days (28 in a single overnight raid on 11 Jul), and Russia closed the **Kerch Strait indefinitely from 18:10 local on 10 July, together with the Don-Azov Canal — both Azov chokepoints shut simultaneously.** ~25% of Russian wheat exports route through Azov and Russia is 22% of world wheat trade, i.e. ~5.5% of world trade at risk; Euronext wheat +4% on 10 Jul to a six-week high, and CBOT wheat is +14.6% on the month. **This is the OTHER war: zero Iranian content. An investor who bills wheat to Hormuz will mis-position on any West Asia ceasefire.** CONFIRMED.

**Russia killed four Indian seafarers off Odesa and India summoned its envoy** — the sharpest bilateral friction of the war period between Delhi and Moscow, and it lands while Russia supplies ~50% of India's crude at or near all-time-high volumes and Washington threatens 100% tariffs over exactly that relationship. Separately the Black Sea chokepoint story is confirmed and is the wheat bid: **Russia suspended all Kerch Strait and Don-Azov transit around 10-11 July** after Ukrainian drone strikes on **100+ Russian vessels in eight days**, with **indefinite grain-vessel restrictions from 13 July**, affecting **~25% of Russian wheat exports** (Russia being 22% of world trade). **Wheat is +11.2% on the month and it is ENTIRELY a Russia story — an investor who bills it to Hormuz will mis-position on any West Asia ceasefire.** Diplomatically Moscow is positioning as broker while expecting escalation (TASS press review: 'Russia offers lifeline on Iran'; 'Trump weighs Iran op expansion'), and is co-sponsoring a **UNSC counter-draft with China condemning strikes on Iran's nuclear sites** against the US/Gulf freedom-of-navigation text. ⚠️ Contamination flagged: the Dynacom vessel *Asia* struck at Novorossiysk CPC on 20 July is the **Ukraine** war, not the Iran war — same owner and same day as the Hormuz strikes. CONFIRMED.

The Kremlin says it is 'in touch' with India after the summons over the four Odesa seafarer deaths (MV Golden Leo, 20 Jul) — Russia's first acknowledgement, contact not apology. This is the sharpest Delhi-Moscow friction of the war period, landing while Russia supplies ~50% of India's crude at record volumes and Washington threatens tariffs over that relationship. Separately the Black Sea chokepoint story remains the WHEAT bid (+14.1% 1M) — Kerch/Azov shut, ~25% of Russian exports affected — with ZERO Iranian content. Moscow continues to position as an Iran broker (TASS 'offers lifeline') while co-sponsoring the UNSC counter-draft with China. CONFIRMED.

The wheat bid HARDENED — CBOT wheat +20.2% on the month (from +14.1%), still ENTIRELY the Russia/Kerch story (Azov chokepoints shut, ~25% of Russian exports affected), with ZERO Iranian content. On the seafarer thread: the death toll off Odesa holds at FOUR (MV Golden Leo, 20 Jul); Jaishankar raised it with Lavrov and the Kremlin says it is 'in touch' — contact, no apology. India has named Tehran and Moscow but still NOT Washington. Moscow continues to resist the US/Gulf UNSC Hormuz draft (vote scheduled Friday 24 Jul). CONFIRMED.
